notes: Enters at logged because D-07b (f) says a navigator's machine is never blocked by the opt-in behavior. The blocking enforcement lives on the dev side: tests/run-all-341.sh runs this same runner as an always-green leg, which is where a regression of the rule is caught before it ships. The runner is offline and starts no process: it drives six named fixture states (fresh, installed, declined-same-version, declined-older-version, never, first-install-reward-pending) through the one decision function and asserts the exact fire or no-fire, the defer flag and the reason for each. It reads no runtime state, so it is green on every machine. The promotion numbers are strict on false positives because a wrong verdict here either nags a navigator or silently drops a card: a 50 run window, a 5 percent ceiling and 3 confirmed true positives. A rung above logged is justified only when an evidence log exists and a human has labeled 3 real regressions the dev side leg did not catch first.
